Stock market news | Tata Steel to buy 26.6% stake in APL Apollo for ₹15,510 crore

On 23 November 2026 Tata Steel announced it will buy a 26.6% promoter stake in APL Apollo Tubes for about ₹15,510 crore and will make an open offer for another 26% at ₹2,301 per share. The acquisition is part of Tata Steel's plan to boost downstream products, creating a 15.5-million tonne steel powerhouse by 2035 and expanding its presence in tubes, pipes and colors businesses.
